---
name: 硬件兼容性 / Hardware report
about: Share real HDMI capture success or failure / 分享实际 HDMI 采集成功或失败的配对结果
title: "[Hardware] "
---

## Devices and connections / 设备与连接

- App version / commit / 版本与提交：
- Phone model and Android version / 手机型号与 Android 版本：
- Capture-card brand/model and VID:PID, no serial number / 采集卡品牌、型号与 VID:PID（不需要序列号）：
- HDMI source, output resolution and refresh rate / HDMI 来源、输出分辨率与刷新率：
- USB/OTG adapters and power supply / USB、OTG 转接与供电方式：
- Actual capture format: encoding, resolution, fps / 实际采集格式：编码、分辨率、fps：

## Results / 实测结果

- Actual moving source video visible, not just color bars / 是否看到实际 HDMI 来源的移动画面（仅彩条不算）：
- Continuous preview duration, observed fps and heat / 连续预览时长、观察到的 fps 与发热情况：
- Retry after denying camera and USB access / 相机和 USB 权限拒绝后重试：
- Background/resume, lock/unlock and at least 5 unplug/replug cycles / 前后台、锁屏恢复、拔插至少 5 次的结果：
- Rotation, fullscreen, zoom and saved format / 旋转、全屏、缩放和格式记忆：
- Untested items / 未测试项目：

## Additional evidence / 补充材料

Follow docs/VALIDATION.md for the full checklist. Distinguish perceived latency from measurements and explain how you measured it. Remove private information from logs and screenshots.

可按 docs/VALIDATION.md 完整验收。请注明延迟是主观感受还是实际测量，并说明测量方法。日志与截图需先移除私人信息。
